plan: Economic theory suggests the dominant strategy is to bid exactly my private value of $26. In a single-round game with no repeated interactions, bidding my true value eliminates the risk of overbidding (losing money) or underbidding (potentially missing out on winning). Since values are drawn independently and randomly, there's no strategic advantage to deviating from my true valuation. I'll bid precisely $26.
